name: Playwright Browser Constitution
description: Configuration for Playwright browser installation and usage - ensures Chromium is installed only once

_metadata.purpose: Prevent repeated Chromium installations by checking installation status first

installation.checkCommand: npx playwright install --dry-run chromium 2>&1 | grep -q 'already installed' && echo 'INSTALLED' || echo 'NOT_INSTALLED'
workflow: 1. Check if Chromium is already installed using checkCommand
3. If dependencies missing, run installDeps (may need sudo)
4. Cache the installation status in memory for session
5. Never reinstall during the same session

mcpConfig.note: MCP Playwright server handles browser lifecycle automatically

beforeFirstUse.description: Check and install if needed - run ONCE at start of testing session
beforeFirstUse.script: if ! ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-* >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx playwright install chromium; fi

mcpUsage.description: Use MCP tools for browser automation - no manual browser management needed

sessionManagement.note: Keep browser open during testing session, close only at end

dependenciesMissing.solution: Run: npx playwright install-deps chromium (may need sudo)

browserCrashed.solution: Close all browser instances and retry

beforeTesting: 1. Check if this is the first Playwright action in the session
2. If first action, verify Chromium is installed
3. If not installed, install ONCE using installCommand
4. Mark installation as complete for this session
duringTesting: 1. Use MCP tools - they manage browser lifecycle
2. Do NOT call install commands again
3. Reuse existing browser session when possible
afterTesting: 1. Close browser only at end of full test session
2. Do not close between individual tests
